purpose: Paired re-measurement of the oWALNUTS strict-track cells of the v38 noncentered Eight Schools confirmation on kernel revision v9 (WP6 endpoint-error fix). Only oWALNUTS is re-run; competitor figures are cited from the frozen v3 release package.

settings.target: v38 noncentered Eight Schools unconstrained density (mu, log tau, z_1..z_8)

seeds.paired_rationale: Re-measurement of a frozen protocol on a new kernel revision; reusing the v38 evidence seeds gives a paired comparison. They are not fresh seeds and are not claimed as such.

timing.estimand: wall strictly around sample_chains_with_target_budget (warm production sampler call), as v38
timing.aggregation_within_seed: median of 5 repetitions; min and max reported
timing.load_caveat: machine shared with other running agents; wall-based numbers are upper bounds on cost, ESS per target call is the machine-independent primary robustness figure

estimators: arviz 1.3: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS with prob (0.05, 0.95); ESS/s = ESS / median wall; ESS/call = ESS / total callbacks started (initialization + warmup + retained), as v38 backend-native work

aggregations_reported.release_v3_style: min over functionals of the across-seed median (this is what the release package's 19,054.65 / 14,494.34 figure is, taken from v38 summaries.rust.across_seeds.tau.*_per_total_second.median)
aggregations_reported.true_conservative_minimum: min over all seeds and all functionals (the wording used in the release text)

gates.health: bulk and tail ESS >= 400 on every functional, rank rhat <= 1.01, divergence rate <= 0.01, max-depth rate <= 0.01, refinement exhaustions == 0, invalid stops == 0, finite samples
gates.posterior_agreement_vs_v38: |mean difference| <= 0.10 pooled posterior SD + 2 pooled MCSE and |SD difference| <= 0.15 pooled posterior SD + 2 pooled MCSE for every functional (v38 rule) against the v38 oWALNUTS posterior moments
gates.question: Do the v9 numbers exceed every strict competitor's v3 minimum (CmdStan 6290.30/3950.59, BlackJAX 5644.66/4195.13, NumPyro 5240.68/4049.60 bulk/tail ESS/s) under (a) the release-style aggregation and (b) the true conservative minimum?

decision_rules: Report all cells. No seed or repetition selection. If the claim survives only under one aggregation, say so explicitly and report the corrected numbers.
